script:
RA=$(control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' --expect 200 --print-header set-cookie | sed -n 's/^oh_app_backend_session=\([^;]*\);.*/\1/p')
RB=$(control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' --expect 200 --print-header set-cookie | sed -n 's/^oh_app_backend_session=\([^;]*\);.*/\1/p')
test -n "$RA" && test -n "$RB"
control-agent-server ws start <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --name f29-revoke --auth none --header "Origin: $S" \
  --header "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$RA" --send qa-f29-before-revoke --duration 120
control-agent-server ws read f29-revoke --contains echo:qa-f29-before-revoke --wait 10 --expect-open
control-agent-server api DELETE <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RA" --expect 204 --check-header set-cookie contains 'oh_app_backend_session=""' \
  --check-header set-cookie contains 'Max-Age=0;' --check-header set-cookie contains 'Path=<redacted:session-cookie>;' \
  --save F29.session-revoke/delete
control-agent-server ws stop f29-revoke --wait 10 --expect-close 1000 --save F29.session-revoke/socket-closed
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RA" --expect 401 \
  --save F29.session-revoke/revoked-cookie
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --auth none --header "Origin: $S" \
  --header "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$RA" --duration 5 --expect-reject 403
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RB" --expect 200 \
  --check app eq qa-backend
control-agent-server api DELETE <redacted:session-cookie>/session --auth none --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RB" --expect 401
control-agent-server api DELETE <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: https://evil.qa.test' \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RB" --expect 403
control-agent-server api DELETE <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header "Origin: $S" \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RB" --expect 409
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RB" --expect 200
control-agent-server api DELETE <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' --expect 204 \
  --check-header set-cookie contains 'Max-Age=0;'
